          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[+()0-9 -]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'

          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be

          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
